title: reckon-observation
description: The fields an observation keeps from its OCSF event that STIX has no property for. Each field is optional.

app_name.description: The application that made an API call.

assignment_group.description: The group a case is assigned to.

person_ref.description: The person a directory record describes. An identity is an SDO, so it cannot be in object_refs.

configuration.description: A cloud resource's configuration, as the snapshot gives it: any JSON value, as OCSF types it.

created_time.description: When a cloud resource was created.

credential_uid.description: The credential an API call was made with.

criticality.description: The source's criticality for the device or resource.

finding_uids.description: Every finding a case is about, when there is more than one.

link.description: A link to a case in its own system.

modified_time.description: When a cloud resource was last changed.

owner_name.description: The owner of a device or cloud resource.

principal_name.description: The name of the principal that made an API call.

privileges.description: The privileges an account change or group change names.

resource_count.description: How many resources the event names.

resource_name.description: The name of the first cloud resource in a snapshot.

resource_type.description: The provider's type for the first cloud resource in a snapshot.

resource_uid.description: The id of the first cloud resource in a snapshot.

service.description: The cloud service an API call went to.

session.description: The session an API call was made in.

sor.description: The system a case is kept in.

user_agent.description: The user agent of an API call.
